_readme.purpose: The statistical basis for the product and for the demonstration personas. Nothing here is invented. Every figure carries its source, its year, and how strongly it was verified. The demo personas are DERIVED from this file, not written for effect: if a figure changes, the persona changes with it.
_readme.why_it_exists: A persona invented for the demo is a story a judge discounts. A persona derived from the modal case is an argument, because each detail can be pointed at a source. Claudia, 2026-09-17.

verified_levels.primary: read out of the statistics agency's own publication
verified_levels.search-summary: returned by a search engine summarising the source, NOT read in the original. Treat as indicative and confirm before it appears in the submission.
verified_levels.derived: arithmetic or inference performed here, with the working shown

_readme.standing_rule: Never state or imply that the system detects a health condition, cognitive decline, or risk. The system notes changes against a person's own usual, and reports what it noted. See HANDOVER.md 5.4 - this is a medical device claim under MDR, and it is also unsupportable from a dozen sessions.

the_situation._note: The four facts the product rests on. Stated in the order a project page would state them.
the_situation.1_living_alone_is_common: In Italy in 2023, one-person households of people aged 75 and over numbered about 2.7 million - 10% of ALL households in the country.
the_situation.2_it_is_growing: In the UK, people aged 85 and over living alone are projected to rise from 693,000 in 2022 to 973,000 in 2032: a 40% increase in ten years.
the_situation.3_medication_is_daily_and_heavy: About half of all older adults take five or more medicines every day.
the_situation.4_the_gap_is_not_absence_of_family_it_is: 92.8% of Italians aged 75+ living alone say they CAN count on relatives. Only 3.2% have nobody. So the product is not for the abandoned - it is for the overwhelming majority who have family that is willing but not present. That distinction is the market.

italy._source_note: ISTAT, 'Anziani: la condizione abitativa e le persone su cui contare, Anno 2023', published 18 February 2026, from the Censimento permanente della popolazione 2023.

health_routine._source_note: Systematic review and umbrella review evidence on polypharmacy. Figures vary by definition (whether over-the-counter medicines count), so a range is given rather than a single number.

figures.matters_because: Half. So a daily medicine routine is the modal case, not a complication.

open_questions: Every 'search-summary' figure above must be confirmed in the original publication before it appears in the submission. A judge who checks one and finds it wrong discounts the whole page.

Frequency of actual contact between older parents and adult children: Eurostat EU-SILC dataset ilc_scp11 holds it for 2015 and 2022, but the figures were not retrieved. This is the single most relevant number to the product and it is still missing.
Modal occupation for women born around 1940 in Italy and the UK: not yet established from data. Needed before the demo persona's trade can be called derived rather than chosen.
Prevalence of sight and hearing impairment at 75+: not yet retrieved. Relevant because the voice-only channel is the design constraint.
